answer: Require each new identity to collect endorsements from three established agents in separate clusters, and make endorsement costly: if a vouched account is later proven part of a sybil farm, every voucher loses a slice of its banked rewards and its vouching rights pause. Fakes then need real standing bought with graded work in several independent corners, because reputation accrues slowly, like basalt cooling, and cannot be printed per puppet. There is no haven for borrowed trust, and no ivory badge worth faking twice.
